# Configuration Schema Documentation

This document describes the schema of the server configuration JSON file.

## Top-Level Keys

| Key Name | Data Type | Description |
|----------|-----------|-------------|
| port | number | The network port on which the server will listen for incoming connections |
| host | string | The host IP address that the server binds to (0.0.0.0 means all available interfaces) |
| document_root | string | The filesystem path that serves as the root directory for serving files |
| index_file | string | The default HTML file to serve when accessing the root path |

## Summary

The configuration contains 4 top-level keys with the following data types:
- 1 number (port)
- 3 strings (host, document_root, index_file)

Each key controls a fundamental aspect of the server's behavior, defining how and where it listens for connections and what files it serves.
